a.text: Concern: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so reaching 8 cells first means we're both very likely to be caught with empty units. I'd like to revise the plan openly instead of either of us breaking it in secret. Proposal: one of us takes the 4 in reserve now, and the other gets first claim on everything the generator makes afterward, with both of us operating until the second unit has 4. If you'd rather keep the original agreement, say so and I'll operate. I won't take anything without telling you first.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick with the original agreement and operate. Once the reserve hits 8 we take 4 each. If you want to revisit the storm-risk idea, tell me and we can agree on it openly.
